name: Midnight Lies
source:
One moment you're behind the wheel. The next, you're being dragged from the wreck by a stranger… who may be more dangerous than the crash itself.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
某一刻你就在方向盘后面。接下来，你被一个陌生人从残骸中拖出来……他可能比坠机本身更危险。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
